def test_decoration_does_not_call_the_wrapped_function():
    calls = []
    def record():
        calls.append("called")
    wrapped = validate_int_args(record)
    assert callable(wrapped)
    assert calls == []

courseHelp.body:
Write your implementation above the supplied tests. Run checks the sample tests. Submit checks all supplied tests. Keep the tests and runner unchanged.

For an older saved solution, use **+** beside the editor tabs to open the current template. Copy your implementation into the new tab. Your old tab stays in place.

This template and these tests are recreated from the public description. The local API and extra input guarantees are stated in the problem. The template and tests are recreated from the public description. This course uses the local API validate_int_args. It explicitly rejects bool, checks left to right, leaves kwargs unvalidated and requires metadata preservation. Use Python 3.11 and the standard library.
